create_DPTDepthModel: create a DPTDepthModel instance with a pretrained ViT backbone for monocular depth estimation
create_DPT_model: create a DPT model with a custom head and configurable ViT backbone architecture
run_DPTDepthModel_forward: run a forward pass through DPTDepthModel to predict depth from an input image tensor
build_fusion_block: build a FeatureFusionBlock_custom instance using _make_fusion_block with specified features and batch norm
review_DPT_forward: review the DPT forward pass that fuses multi-scale ViT features through four refinement paths
